title: Customer Portal Incident Response
description: Customer portal incidents affecting insurance customer service
immediate_actions: Assess impact on customer service and customer experience
Implement alternative customer service channels if needed
Contact customer service team for customer inquiry management
investigation_steps: Review customer portal logs and status
Check web server and application server status
Analyze web traffic patterns for anomalies
resolution_steps: Restart customer portal services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply portal patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with portal vendor for complex issues
verification: Confirm with customer service that portal is operational
special_considerations: Customer portal is important for customer satisfaction
Regulatory reporting deadlines require priority escalation
Coordinate with customer service for customer communication
Document any portal interruptions that may affect customer service
